subject: health
concept: Designing a personal, sustainable movement routine that fits an individual's real schedule and preferences
source_inspiration: original content, deliberately framed around sustainability and enjoyment rather than appearance or numeric targets — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches a lifestyle constraint (busy schedule, limited equipment) to a realistic movement option that fits it
exercise.abstract: Student designs a personal movement routine that realistically fits their own schedule and preferences

assessment.mastery_threshold: routine is realistic, specific, and something the student could actually sustain
misconception_flags: designs an unsustainable or unrealistic routine disconnected from their own actual schedule or preferences

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
